figures.caption: MICs of the lipopeptides derived from BP100 against the bacteria E. amylovora (Ea), P. syringae pv. syringae (Pss), P. syringae pv. actinidiae (Psa), X. arboricola pv. pruni (Xap), X. fragariae (Xf), and X. axonopodis pv. vesicatoria (Xav), and the fungi P. expansum (Pe) and F. oxysporum (Fo).The position of the acyl group at the N-terminus is indicated by a N, and the position of the acylated Lys by numbers 1 to 11. The type of the acyl group is depicted as R = COC5H11 (hexanoyl), R = COC3H7 (butanoyl) and R = COC11H23 (lauroyl).
figures.label: Fig 1
